name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I'm writing about the Client Partner, Media & Entertainment role. I want to be completely direct rather than waste your time: I don't have existing relationships with streaming, studio, gaming, or broadcast executives, and I haven't sold advertising within the Media & Entertainment industry specifically. That's the core of what this role is built around, and I'd rather say so plainly than have it surface in a first conversation.

What I do bring is a real track record of exceeding revenue targets and closing complex commercial deals: top three in sales on a team of 8 to 15 reps at Accelo while quota roughly doubled, C-suite relationships built as a trusted advisor on operational system design, and consistent deal closing across multiple sales roles. I also bring something less common: I don't just use AI tools, I build agent-based automation and structured prompting systems that run in production today, as founder of my own practice. I understand how these systems actually work under the hood, not just how to sell around them.

I'm applying because OpenAI's mission and this specific problem, how AI reshapes advertising and audience discovery, genuinely interests me, not because I think I'm a conventional fit for this seat. If there's ever a case where real AI fluency and a proven sales track record matter more than an existing Media & Entertainment rolodex, I'd welcome the conversation. If not, I understand, and I appreciate you reading this far.
